schema.title: Influence Line Plate Force Data Request
schema.description: Request body for one plate force or moment influence-line data result.

Argument.description: Plate force or moment influence data query arguments.

EXPORT_PATH.description: Optional output file path. When omitted, no file is saved. A .txt extension saves the original MIDAS text layout; a .json extension saves the structured JSON result.

UNIT.description: Unit system used for the returned influence data.

FORCE.description: Force unit, such as kN or N.

DIST.description: Distance unit, such as m or mm.

LANE_NAME.description: Selected line or surface lane name.

KEY_ELEM.description: Plate element number at which the force or moment influence is evaluated.

COMPONENTS.description: Plate position and force or moment component.

COMP.description: One plate force or moment component.
